product_integration.next_step: Run current-cohort packaged D, real-reference multi-view visual/PBR review, export/restart hash and human gates

limitations: The accepted product scope is a bounded same-Part Worker adapter; it does not make Manifold a general Runtime library or expose arbitrary user mesh operations.
The Worker carries vendored fixed-revision C/C++ source and links it into the isolated binary; there is no dynamically loaded libmanifold package.
The product and isolated benchmarks use bounded synthetic meshes; they do not prove arbitrary user-mesh quality, GLB/PBR likeness, human review, export/restart hash, or 360-degree quality.
The build-host gate is macOS arm64 only; cross-platform packaging and distribution signing remain NOT_RUN.
The cached manifold-rust crate was not used as a substitute for the frozen C API adoption gate.
